english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a great many people, such as accountants, rather than for a military unit.
Use this colloquial construction before a people noun for a large group working on the same task.

examples.english: There is a legion of people queuing at the venue entrance.
examples.traditional: 會場門口有一大班人排緊隊。
examples.jyutping: wui2 coeng4 mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 daai6 baan1 jan4 paai4 gan2 deoi6

examples.english: An army of volunteers helped distribute supplies.
examples.traditional: 有一大班義工幫手派物資。
examples.jyutping: jau5 jat1 daai6 baan1 ji6 gung1 bong1 sau2 paai3 mat6 zi1
